source.description: Reviewed handmade raster graphite and colored-pencil process contact sheet.
source.notes: One top-view monarch resting over one goldenrod spray; no labels, arrows, UI, signatures, watermarks, extra insects, or decorative border.

process_strategy: Eight cumulative panels build a body-and-wing scaffold into four stable wings, monarch markings, one three-cluster goldenrod spray, graphite value, and restrained color before a finishing-only pass.

progression_contract.blank_page_test: A beginner can copy Panel 1 in under two minutes using one body axis, one small thorax oval, four open wing gesture arcs, one diagonal stem route, and three flower placement circles.

anchor_map.early_mark: One vertical body axis with a small thorax oval
anchor_map.becomes: The monarch head, thorax, and tapered abdomen
anchor_map.fixed_relationship: The four wings attach around the thorax and the abdomen stays centered between the hindwings.
anchor_map.construction_note: Pale guide only; no finished body contour in Panel 1.

anchor_map.becomes: Two broad forewings and two rounded hindwings
anchor_map.fixed_relationship: Each arc begins at the thorax and keeps the same outward angle and endpoint through every later panel.
anchor_map.construction_note: Open arcs until Panel 2; no closed wing contours in Panel 1.

anchor_map.early_mark: One diagonal stem route with three flower placement circles
anchor_map.becomes: One goldenrod spray with exactly three flower clusters
anchor_map.fixed_relationship: The center cluster remains directly beneath the butterfly body while the other two branch left and right from the same stem.
anchor_map.construction_note: Routes and placement circles only until Panel 5.

final_elements.name: butterfly and flower construction guides
final_elements.description: One body axis, thorax oval, four wing arcs, one stem route, and three flower placement circles.

final_elements.name: four-wing monarch silhouette
final_elements.description: Exactly two broad forewings and two rounded hindwings arranged symmetrically around the body axis.

final_elements.name: body antennae and wing veins
final_elements.description: One small head, textured thorax, tapered abdomen, two antennae, and the main vein routes in all four wings.

final_elements.name: monarch border and cell markings
final_elements.description: Broad dark wing borders, divided orange cells, and small pale edge spots mapped before color.

final_elements.name: goldenrod spray
final_elements.description: One curved stem with exactly three clustered flower heads and exactly two narrow leaves.

final_elements.name: graphite texture and restrained color map
final_elements.description: Graphite texture plus the full orange, black-brown, golden-yellow, and muted-green color decisions.

final_elements.name: flower detail and broken ground suggestion
final_elements.description: Small clustered bloom dots, leaf veins, and a faint broken graphite suggestion beneath the spray.

overlap_reservations.background_lines_stop_before: Goldenrod flower and stem keeper lines stop beneath the butterfly body and lower wings; no dark floral detail is drawn through the insect.

frames.visible_job: Place one body axis, one thorax oval, four open wing arcs, one diagonal stem route, and three flower placement circles.
Connect the four established arcs into two broad forewings and two rounded hindwings without moving their attachment points.
Add the head, thorax, tapered abdomen, two antennae, and main vein routes inside the established four wings.
Divide the wings into broad monarch cells, dark border bands, and small pale edge-spot reserves.
Turn the stem route and three placement circles into one branching goldenrod spray with exactly three flower clusters and two narrow leaves.
Add directional graphite and map every orange, black-brown, golden-yellow, and muted-green region on the established butterfly and spray.
introduces: graphite texture and restrained color map
establishes: graphite texture and restrained color map

frames.visible_job: Clarify the established bloom dots, leaf veins, wing texture, and faint broken graphite suggestion without adding new forms.
introduces: flower detail and broken ground suggestion
establishes: flower detail and broken ground suggestion
requires_prior_elements: graphite texture and restrained color map

new_occlusions: The butterfly body and lower wings sit in front of the center goldenrod cluster.

must_persist: graphite texture and restrained color map
graphite texture and restrained color map
flower detail and broken ground suggestion

final_step.visible_job: Only strengthen established keeper contours, deepen the mapped graphite and color, and clarify existing edge spots, bloom dots, and highlights.

rejection_checks: Reject a detailed first panel, a sheet with fewer or more than four stable wings, or shifting wing attachment points.
Reject a goldenrod spray that changes from exactly three clusters and two leaves after it appears.
Reject a final that introduces wing cells, edge spots, flowers, leaves, color regions, or another insect absent earlier.
Reject vector-like linework, glossy poster rendering, repeated darkened tracings, labels, arrows, text, signatures, or watermarks.
